enriched_activities.activity: Sleeping in on a Saturday morning, fan on for air circulation
enriched_activities.desc: Lie on bed. Eyes closed. Breathe slowly. Fan running. Turn to left side. Pull blanket. Turn to right side. Adjust pillow. Remain asleep.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, washing face, brushing teeth and taking a warm shower
enriched_activities.desc: Open eyes. Sit up. Swing legs off bed. Stand up. Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on water heater. Wait for water to warm. Turn on shower. Step into shower. Wet body. Apply soap. Rub body. Rinse body. Turn off shower. Step out. Pick up towel. Dry body. Wrap towel around waist. Walk to sink. Turn on tap. Wet face. Apply face wash. Rub face. Rinse face. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Spit. Turn off tap. Wipe face with towel. Turn off light. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Making and eating breakfast with the kettle and toaster, brewing tea
enriched_activities.desc: Enter kitchen. Turn on light. Fill kettle with water. Plug in kettle. Turn on kettle. Open cupboard. Take out tea bag. Put tea bag in mug. Pour hot water into mug. Let tea steep. Open fridge. Take out bread. Take out butter. Open toaster. Put bread in toaster. Push down toaster lever. Wait for toast. Toast pops up. Take out toast. Put on plate. Spread butter. Sit at table. Eat toast. Drink tea.

enriched_activities.activity: Clearing breakfast dishes, wiping counters and running the dishwasher
enriched_activities.desc: Pick up plates. Scrape food into bin. Stack dishes. Carry to sink. Rinse dishes. Open dishwasher. Load dishwasher. Add detergent. Close dishwasher door. Press start button. Pick up cloth. Wet cloth. Wipe counters. Rinse cloth. Wring cloth. Wipe table. Put cloth away. Turn off kitchen light.

enriched_activities.activity: Weekend chores: vacuuming floors and tidying the living area
enriched_activities.desc: Enter living room. Pick up items from floor. Put items in drawer. Move coffee table. Plug in vacuum cleaner. Turn on vacuum. Push vacuum across floor. Move around furniture. Vacuum under sofa. Turn off vacuum. Unplug vacuum. Wrap cord. Put vacuum in closet. Arrange cushions on sofa. Fold blanket. Put blanket on sofa. Turn off living room light.

enriched_activities.activity: Walking to the local market for the weekly grocery shopping
enriched_activities.desc: Put on shoes. Grab reusable bags. Open door. Walk out. Lock door. Walk to market. Cross street. Enter market. Pick up basket. Walk to produce section. Select apples. Put apples in basket. Select bananas. Select tomatoes. Select lettuce. Walk to meat section. Select chicken. Walk to dairy section. Select milk. Go to checkout. Pay cashier. Put items in bags. Walk home. Unlock door. Enter home. Close door.

enriched_activities.activity: Unpacking and organising groceries into the refrigerator and cupboards
enriched_activities.desc: Put bags on counter. Open fridge. Take out milk. Place milk in fridge. Take out vegetables. Place vegetables in fridge. Take out meat. Place meat in freezer. Open cupboard. Place canned goods in cupboard. Place pasta in cupboard. Close cupboard. Close fridge. Fold reusable bags. Put bags away.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking a light midday meal on the induction cooker and eating it
enriched_activities.desc: Take out vegetables. Wash vegetables. Chop vegetables. Turn on induction cooker. Place pan on cooker. Add oil. Add vegetables. Stir vegetables. Add salt. Add spices. Turn off cooker. Put food on plate. Carry plate to table. Sit at table. Eat meal. Drink water. Finish eating. Pick up plate. Carry to sink. Rinse plate.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing on the sofa watching TV with the air conditioner on
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Sit on sofa. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Turn on air conditioner. Adjust temperature. Flip channels. Stop on news channel. Watch TV. Lean back. Put feet on ottoman. Watch for a while. Change channel. Watch movie.

enriched_activities.activity: Afternoon leisure: brisk walk and casual sports at the neighbourhood park
enriched_activities.desc: Put on sports shoes. Walk to park. Start brisk walk. Increase pace. Jog lightly. Stop at bench. Do stretches. Touch toes. Stretch arms. Walk to open area. Throw frisbee. Catch frisbee. Kick ball. Run after ball. Sit on grass. Drink water from bottle. Walk back home.

enriched_activities.activity: Showering and changing out of sweaty clothes after exercise
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on water heater. Undress. Step into shower. Wet body. Apply soap. Rub body. Rinse body. Turn off shower. Step out. Pick up towel. Dry body. Dry hair. Put on clean clothes. Turn off light. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Using the computer to review next week's community program schedule and note the new peak electricity hours (16:00-21:00) from Monday
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at desk. Turn on computer. Open calendar. Review schedule for next week. Open notes app. Write down peak electricity hours (16:00-21:00). Save note. Close calendar. Shut down computer. Stand up.

enriched_activities.activity: Preparing dinner, chopping vegetables and cooking on the induction cooker while the range hood runs
enriched_activities.desc: Open fridge. Take out vegetables. Wash vegetables. Chop vegetables. Turn on range hood. Turn on induction cooker. Place pan on cooker. Add oil. Add vegetables. Stir vegetables. Add seasoning. Cover pan. Wait. Turn off cooker. Turn off range hood. Put food on plates.

enriched_activities.activity: Eating dinner and cleaning up the table
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at table. Eat dinner. Drink water. Finish eating. Pick up plates. Scrape food into bin. Stack plates. Carry to sink. Rinse plates. Load dishwasher. Wipe table. Turn off kitchen light. Walk to living room.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing with TV and light reading under the air conditioner
enriched_activities.desc: Sit on sofa. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Turn on air conditioner. Adjust temperature. Pick up book. Open book. Read. Watch TV. Put down book. Watch TV. Pick up book again. Read. Put down book. Turn off TV. Turn off air conditioner. Stand up. Walk to bedroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Winding down with the desk lamp on, browsing the phone and reading before bed
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bedroom. Turn on desk lamp. Sit on bed. Pick up phone. Open phone. Browse social media. Put down phone. Pick up book. Open book. Read. Put down book. Turn off desk lamp. Lie down.

enriched_activities.activity: Night routine: washing face, brushing teeth and preparing for bed
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Wet face. Apply cleanser. Rub face. Rinse face. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Spit. Turn off tap. Wipe face with towel. Turn off light. Walk to bedroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Sleeping, fan running at low speed for comfort
enriched_activities.desc: Lie on bed. Turn on fan. Set fan to low speed. Pull blanket over body. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Remain asleep.
